title: Your firm here — founding free post

title: Claims Advocate (Path to Licensed Public Adjuster)
blurb: Salaried NY seat that pays for your public adjuster license while you learn financial-loss claim advocacy.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers is hiring a Claims Advocate at its Melville, Long Island office, aimed at people coming from accounting, finance, insurance customer service, or claims.

The firm covers licensing and training so the hire can become a licensed public adjuster within a few months, then work business interruption, builder's risk, and property damage files using financial records to support the claim.
The page lists a $75k–$85k salary (based on experience) plus bonus, health benefits, and PTO; submit a resume through the careers page.

title: Property Insurance Claims Adjuster
blurb: Experienced property adjuster to run policyholder claims from intake to settlement for a Long Island PA firm.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers wants a seasoned property adjuster, from either the carrier or public side, to manage residential and commercial claims for policyholders.

The work is mostly in the office: reviewing estimates, engineering reports, and policy language, building claim packages, and negotiating with carriers, with some joint inspections in the field. It asks for 3+ years of property adjusting and a NY public adjuster license or willingness to get one.
Pay is listed at $75k–$110k plus medical coverage and PTO.

title: Insurance Claims Manager
blurb: Leadership role steering a portfolio of policyholder property claims and mentoring the adjuster team.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers is hiring a Claims Manager to coordinate strategy and day-to-day progress on residential and commercial property claims for policyholders.

The manager oversees active files, mentors adjusters and support staff, negotiates settlements, and makes sure files are ready for appraisal, mediation, or litigation. Requirements include 5+ years in property claims and Xactimate experience; a NYS public adjuster license is preferred.
The posting lists a $110k–$130k salary with medical coverage and PTO.

title: Public Adjuster
blurb: Licensed Texas PA to inspect, estimate, and negotiate claims while helping grow a Houston franchise office.
description: Tiger Adjusters, a franchise-based public adjusting firm, is looking for an experienced licensed public adjuster for its Houston market.

Daily work covers documenting property damage, reviewing policies for gaps or errors, writing Xactimate estimates, and negotiating settlements with carriers, plus business development to grow the office. A Texas public adjuster license is required.
Full-time, with pay negotiated based on experience; the posting asks applicants to email a resume and LinkedIn profile.

title: Public Adjuster
blurb: Licensed New Jersey PA to handle claims end to end and build business for a Trenton franchise office.
description: Tiger Adjusters is hiring an experienced public adjuster for its Trenton, New Jersey location as part of its growing franchise network.

The role includes property inspections, policy analysis, Xactimate estimating, carrier negotiation, and supporting attorneys when a claim is disputed, along with sales and outreach. A New Jersey public adjuster license is required.
Full-time, with pay negotiated based on experience; applicants send a resume per the posting.

title: Field and Sales Representative
blurb: Hybrid sales-and-field role at a PA firm: win clients and inspect storm damage across Greater Omaha.
description: Swift Public Adjusters is hiring a full-time Field & Sales Representative for Omaha who both brings in clients and inspects their property damage.

The job combines referral networking and presentations with on-site storm-damage inspections, scope-of-loss reports, policy review, and coordination with carriers and contractors. A public adjusting license is required, or must be obtained within a month of hire.
Compensation starts as a $50k–$65k draw against uncapped commission, with health, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.

title: Licensed Outside Sales Representative
blurb: Licensed sales seat signing property owners for a PA firm in the St. Louis market, with draw and benefits.
description: Swift Public Adjusters wants an outside sales representative to grow its client base across the St. Louis region.

The rep builds referral partnerships, meets with residential and commercial property owners, screens referred claims, and reports on territory activity. A public adjusting license is required, or must be earned within a month of starting.
Pay begins as a $50k–$65k draw against uncapped commission, with full benefits. Swift also lists similar seats in Kansas City and Springfield, MO.

title: Field Public Adjuster / Senior Public Adjuster
blurb: Phoenix-area PA firm hiring field and senior adjusters with base pay, paid training, and licensing support.
description: Select Adjusters, an Advosy-backed public adjusting firm in Mesa, is hiring across the Phoenix Valley.

Field Public Adjusters inspect and document damage and work with homeowners; an Arizona PA license is preferred, and the firm will help the right candidate get one. Senior Public Adjusters need the license already and lead complex claims and carrier negotiations. The page also lists claims coordinator and office roles.
Pay is base salary plus performance pay tied to claim results, with paid training; apply through the form on the careers page.

title: Public Adjusters (Licensed) & Public Adjuster Apprentices
location: NY, NJ, CT, GA, NC, SC, TX, FL
blurb: Commission-based licensed PA and apprentice openings across eight states, with training for newcomers.
description: Panther Public Adjusting is hiring licensed public adjusters and apprentices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Georgia, the Carolinas, Texas, and Florida.

Licensed adjusters need an active PA license in one of those states and handle damage assessment, claim filing, and carrier negotiation. Apprentices need no prior experience; they train under senior adjusters while working toward a license.
Pay is commission on successful claims with a flexible schedule; apply by emailing a resume as described on the careers page.

title: Apprentice Public Insurance Adjuster
blurb: Full-time entry-level seat at a Philadelphia-area PA firm that trains you toward a public adjuster license.
description: MLA Claims, a public adjusting and property loss consulting firm near Philadelphia, has a full-time, entry-level apprentice opening.

The apprentice handles contents inventories and pricing in Excel, measures and photographs loss sites, schedules inspections, and does office tasks, building the experience needed for licensure. A bachelor's degree, a valid driver's license, and a vehicle are required.
Pay depends on experience, and healthcare and a 401(k) are offered.

title: Licensed Public Adjuster
blurb: Florida PA firm looking for licensed adjusters or licensed apprentices to sign and manage new claims.
description: Cohen & Associates Public Adjusters, in business since 2005, is looking for licensed public adjusters to bring in and handle residential and commercial claims.

Applicants need a Florida 3-20 public adjuster license or a 31-20 apprentice license, with bond in good standing. The work includes networking with roofers, plumbers, contractors, and property managers for leads, keeping clients updated, and meeting carrier adjusters at inspections.
Xactimate, negotiation skills, and being bilingual are all pluses.

title: Public Adjuster & Solicitor
blurb: Licensed Florida PA to work firm-generated leads and grow commercial and residential referrals for a 30-year firm.
description: Tutwiler & Associates, a public adjusting firm based in Tampa with more than 30 years in business, is looking for licensed public adjusters to sign homeowners and commercial property owners.

The role follows up on leads the firm generates and builds relationships with property managers and businesses. It requires a current all-lines Florida PA license (3-20), 2+ years of experience, and your own laptop, phone, camera, and transportation.
Compensation is discussed after an interview; the careers page explains how to send a resume.

title: Public Adjuster
blurb: Experienced restoration or carrier-claims path into CA public adjusting, with structured oversight toward a license.
description: Allied Public Adjusters is hiring Public Adjusters for Glendale and Newport Beach with field work across Southern California.
The seat is aimed at insurance-restoration or carrier claims managers who will inspect, estimate, and advocate for policyholders while working toward a California Public Adjuster license.
Base pay is listed around $65k–$100k with overtime eligibility; confirm schedule and apply steps on the Greenhouse posting.

title: Senior Public Adjuster
blurb: Licensed CA PA for complex files with sales support, estimators, and in-house counsel.
description: Allied Public Adjusters is hiring Senior Public Adjusters for in-person work in Glendale or Newport Beach, California.
An active California Public Adjuster license and deep claims experience are required; the firm feeds clients so you can focus on investigation, estimates, and negotiation.
Compensation is listed with base roughly $85k–$110k and OTE about $160k–$225k; see Greenhouse for benefits and apply.

title: Executive Desk Public Adjuster
blurb: Senior desk PA partnering with field EPAs on large-loss and high-value files.
description: Allied Public Adjusters posted an Executive Desk Public Adjuster role for remote day-to-day ownership of shared large-loss caseloads.
You partner with an Executive Public Adjuster in the field, run carrier and client communication, and drive supplements and negotiations from the desk.
Expect 7+ years of property claims experience and an active PA license or ability to obtain one within 90 days; base is listed at about $110k–$150k plus bonus.

title: Senior Estimator
location: Glendale / Los Angeles / Newport Beach, CA
blurb: PA-firm senior estimator owning field scoping and defensible Xactimate estimates.
description: Allied Public Adjusters is hiring a Senior Estimator to support public adjusters on complex water, fire, and structural losses in Southern California.
The role owns field investigation, Xactimate production, and defending scopes when carriers push back.
Requirements include 7+ years of insurance restoration estimating; base is listed around $110k–$135k plus a performance bonus.

title: Public Insurance Adjuster Trainee
location: GA (also NC, WV, MD, WI, SD postings)
blurb: Entry trainee path with training and licensing support; no prior adjusting experience required.
description: Metro Public Adjustment is hiring Public Insurance Adjuster Trainees for several states, including Georgia, with parallel Greenhouse posts for NC, WV, MD, WI, and SD.
Trainees assist on inspections, policy review, and claim documentation under senior adjusters; training and licensing support are offered.
Compensation is listed in a broad $35k–$125k band; apply on Greenhouse for the state seat that matches you.

title: Remote Claims Representative
blurb: Newest Metro remote claims-rep seat with free training and commission pay.
description: Metro Public Adjustment refreshed a Remote Claims Representative posting (updated mid-October 2026) focused on Pennsylvania with a multi-state apply list.

Pay is commission-based in a stated $35k–$150k range; read the Greenhouse ad carefully for which states they will and will not hire.

title: Licensed Public Adjuster – Destin
blurb: Hybrid, commission-based Destin PA seat with firm leads, mentorship, and full back-office support.
description: Rockwall National Public Adjusters, a policyholder-side firm with more than 15 years in the business, is adding a licensed public adjuster in the Destin area on a hybrid, commission-based contractor basis.

The adjuster solicits residential and commercial claims and referral partners, then signs, inspects, documents, and negotiates each loss for the policyholder. An active Florida public adjuster license (or the ability to get one) is required; adjusting, construction, or restoration experience is preferred but not mandatory.

Newer licensees get structured training and mentorship, experienced adjusters get qualified leads and claims systems, and the office handles contracts, compliance, invoicing, and mortgage-company payments. Apply through the BambooHR posting.

title: Business Development Lead (PT/FT) – Western PA
location: Western Pennsylvania (work from home + local outreach)
blurb: Build a referral network for a 30-year PA firm across western Pennsylvania, part-time or full-time, with training provided.
description: Metro Public Adjustment, a policyholder-side firm in business for more than 30 years, wants a Business Development Lead to grow its presence across western Pennsylvania.

The role builds referral relationships with chambers of commerce, networking groups, contractors, real estate agents, and local businesses, sets up in-person and virtual meetings, and helps home and business owners understand their coverage.
No experience is required: Metro provides training, lets you earn while you learn, and offers a path to build and lead your own team. Apply through the Greenhouse posting.

title: Loss Documentation Field Inspector – Nationwide Travel
blurb: Salaried, travel-heavy field role documenting property losses for policyholders the way an adjuster would.
description: Velocity Public Adjusting (VPA) is hiring Loss Documentation Field Inspectors who travel across the U.S. about 75% of the time to inspect and document property damage for its policyholder clients. No relocation is required.

Inspectors go top to bottom on each property, including roofs, interiors, and structure, and capture detailed photos and written reports from a coverage point of view rather than a contractor's, working with insureds, engineers, and VPA's internal team.

The job is salaried with full benefits and no commission. VPA looks for field adjusting, inspection, or loss documentation experience and says it suits independent adjusters and newer public adjusters. Apply on the posting page.

title: Licensed Public Insurance Adjuster
blurb: Full-time licensed PA seat at a suburban Philadelphia firm, with salary plus commission, healthcare, and 401(k).
description: MLA Claims, a property loss consulting and public adjusting firm headquartered in Lafayette Hill outside Philadelphia, is hiring a licensed public insurance adjuster for a full-time role.

The adjuster handles property claims start to finish: inspecting losses, building estimates and documentation, advising clients, negotiating settlements, and signing both new and in-house leads. It asks for a valid Pennsylvania and/or New Jersey PA license, two or more years of relevant experience, and damage estimating skills (Xactimate a plus).
Pay is salary plus commission based on experience, with healthcare and a 401(k). Apply through the posting or by emailing a resume to the firm.

title: Property Damage Estimator / Insurance & Construction Expert
location: New York Tri-State Area (field, vehicle required)
blurb: Field estimator role writing Xactimate scopes that catch what carrier adjusters miss, across NY, NJ, and CT.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers is hiring a full-time property damage estimator to inspect residential and commercial losses across the New York Tri-State area, with occasional travel beyond it.

The estimator writes detailed repair estimates in Xactimate, flags code upgrades and hidden damage carrier adjusters often miss, and supports public adjusters, contents specialists, and claim managers with documentation and joint inspections.
Requirements include at least 3 years of property damage estimating or construction experience, Xactimate proficiency, and a reliable vehicle. Submit a resume through the careers page.

title: Contents (Personal Property) Insurance Claims Adjuster
blurb: Salaried contents specialist role inventorying and pricing personal property losses for policyholders.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers wants a contents adjuster at its Melville, Long Island office to document and value personal property lost or damaged in fires, water losses, storms, and other insured events.

The adjuster builds detailed inventories, researches replacement values, works with field adjusters and estimators, and prepares contents reports for carriers. Prior contents claims experience and familiarity with pricing tools are expected.
The posting lists a $70k–$90k salary plus health benefits. Submit a resume through the careers page.

title: Business Development Associate – Manhattan Territory
blurb: Salary-plus-commission sales role bringing in Manhattan property claims, with PA licensing within 90 days.
description: United Public Adjusters & Appraisers is expanding in Manhattan and hiring a full-time Business Development Associate to bring in commercial and residential property claims.

The role works existing relationships with property owners, managers, resident managers, and supers, represents the firm at industry events, manages a pipeline in the CRM, and helps on site visits. Hires must get a public adjuster license within 90 days, with training provided.
Pay is salary plus commission with fully paid benefits; a proven sales record and Manhattan real estate connections are expected. Submit a resume through the careers page.

title: Outside Sales Representative – Denver, CO
blurb: Draw-plus-commission sales seat building referral partners for a PA firm in the Denver market.
description: Swift Public Adjusters is hiring an Outside Sales Representative for the Denver market, a remote role with in-person outreach across the Rocky Mountain region.

The rep builds a network of referral sources, meets residential and commercial property owners, educates partners about public adjusting, screens referred claims, and reports daily activity and territory forecasts.

Pay starts with a $50k–$65k draw against uncapped commission after a 30–60 day probation, plus health, dental, vision, and a 401(k). A public adjuster license is required within a month of hire, and a business degree or five years of sales experience is expected. Apply through the posting.

Pay starts with a $50k–$65k draw against uncapped commission after a 30–60 day probation, plus health, dental, vision, and a 401(k). A public adjuster license is required within a month of hire, and a business degree or five years of sales experience is expected. Apply through the posting.
